verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax provides itemized and summary reporting exports of tax transaction data (docs-11, docs-19), which could be considered an open-format (CSV) export, but there is no evidence of a full account/data export mechanism or any documented way to migrate all Stripe Tax configuration, tax codes, or registrations elsewhere. Missing for 10: comprehensive data export beyond transaction reports, explicit open-format guarantee, and any documented 'leave/migrate' workflow.
